title: On save the part is matched to the library ignoring capitals and symbols
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit". A library entry exists for part number "BRK-100"; no entry exists for a fresh number like "ZZAUTOTEST-NEW-1".
custom_steps:
1. Create a part typing a number that matches an existing entry only in case/punctuation (e.g. "brk 100" or "brk.100").
  2. Save and confirm the part links to the existing entry with no mention of the library.
  3. Create a part with a brand-new number and save; confirm it works with no mention of the library.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On save the system searches the part library for the typed number, ignoring upper/lower case and ignoring hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces; if exactly one entry matches the part links to it, and if none matches it creates a new entry and links the part.
  • The user is not told about the part library when exactly one entry matches or when none matches.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 7 (Create a part without a library item); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “On save, the system searches the part library for an entry with the part number the user typed.”
  • S7-R5: “The search ignores upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R6: “The search also ignores hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces in the part number.”
  • S7-R7: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R8: “If no entry matches, the system creates a new part library entry and links the part to it.”
  • S7-R10: “The user is not told about the part library when exactly one entry matches or when none matches.”
